purpose: Evidence for next development direction after a failed raw-rescue localization pilot; not new implementation or evidence of EV accuracy.

sources.title: Decision Fusion-Based Non-Intrusive Load Identification Involving Adaptive Threshold Event Detection
sources.read: Abstract and methods text, especially locally partitioned means/variances and previous-subinterval thresholds in adaptive CUSUM.
sources.useful_idea: Thresholds based on local operating-state variability instead of one global fixed band. This motivates testing a better observed-return criterion.
sources.limits: The paper concerns residential appliance event/identity detection and PLAID, not these EV recovery-completion labels. Its normal-based Pauta thresholds do not provide a risk guarantee here. No CUSUM/Softmax/UI-waveform implementation or claimed reproduction in this pilot.

sources.title: Adaptive Event Detection for Representative Load Signature Extraction
sources.read: Author abstract describing WAMMA adaptive windows, margins and thresholds and separate transient/steady periods.
sources.useful_idea: Treat a transition and the next steady state explicitly rather than a single level-crossing time.
sources.limits: Older methodological source, not presented as the latest paper. Evaluated above1Hz on20/50/60Hz data; these EV windows are mostly about4-second reports, so direct transfer is unproven and no implementation/adoption has occurred.

recent_lead_not_used_as_implementation_a.title: A multi-window CUSUM method with adaptive threshold and variable-length window for nonintrusive load monitoring
recent_lead_not_used_as_implementation_a.status: Primary publisher fetch unavailable; bibliographic search lead only, not used to assert verified algorithm details or reproduce results.

independent_judgment: Adding a larger neural or tree model is not justified by62 resolved training anchor labels and18 validation labels. First change the recovery/state definition in a small prospectively specified candidate, then expand reliable references and evaluate without test feedback.
